snapshot: WHO European Region. A long-time global health donor (Global Fund, Unitaid, Gavi) now cutting back: in February 2026 it more than halved its Global Fund pledge and reduced development aid. The health portfolio sits with the Ministry of Health, Families, Autonomy and Persons with Disabilities.

leadership.role: Minister of Health, Families, Autonomy and Persons with Disabilities
leadership.name: Stéphanie Rist

agenda.title: Cut to the Global Fund pledge
agenda.text: On 12 February 2026 France announced a pledge of EUR 660 million for the Global Fund's 2026 to 2028 cycle, down 58% from EUR 1.6 billion for the previous cycle. Coalition Plus and AIDES criticised the decision as a desertion.

agenda.title: Overall development aid down
agenda.text: The 2026 budget reduces French development aid by EUR 800 million, 18% less than in 2025 and 38% less than in 2024.
